XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine malfunction indicator light coming on, with sudden engine shutdown while running
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0089 | SUCTION | FUEL | DIESEL | DIESEL FUEL | IGNITES | IGNITED | MIL | YELLOW | YELLOW LIGHT | CAUSES | LOSES | DROPS | LACK | POWER | SPEED | DROP | WHEN ACCELERATING | INCREASING | SPEED |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Fuel pump

  • Fault: During acceleration, the engine fault light comes on and there are sporadic drops in performance. Restarting the vehicle temporarily resolves the problem.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0089 (Fuel pressure regulator 1 – Incorrect operating range)

  • Cause: Fuel suction pipe clogged

• Action: Check the condition of the fuel dipstick and clean it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component in question is located in the passenger compartment, next to the driver’s seat, on the right-hand side; it is accessible after opening the appropriate inspection panel.

    The estimated time for the procedure is approximately 1.7 hours.
